purpose: Complete low-resolution all-tracked-instrument mapping. Pool assignments are deterministic research hypotheses, not verified counterparties, contracts, shares or revenue observations.
classification_procedure: For each tracked symbol assign probable economic roles and one or more existing pool IDs by business model. If no supported or credible category, leave unclassified and flag for identity/customer research; never invent relationships.

coverage.description: Classifications are hypotheses only, not verified economic participation. All 198 equity/receipt-like instruments have at least one provisional pool role or non-pool cross-cutting role; 93 nonissuer instruments remain contextual signals.

stages.name: identity
stages.action: Resolve issuer identity, exchange, ADR and corporate hierarchy; distinguish fund/index from issuing company

stages.name: buyer_purpose_pool
stages.action: Identify identifiable procurement budgets/purchasing purposes and buyers in each pool, not just sectors

stages.name: competition
stages.action: List actual selected vendors, competitors, internal-build alternatives and product qualification; separate observed from suspected

stages.name: contracts
stages.action: Find first-party signed purchase, partnership, ownership, prepayment or offtake evidence, with source and publication/effective dates

stages.name: dollar_capture
stages.action: Record buyer-pool denominator and vendor recognized or awarded amounts, in matched periods and USD/FX; null absent proof

stages.name: upstream
stages.action: Follow vendor's procurement to at least one upstream tier where independently sourced; do not sum consecutive revenues as independent demand

stages.name: capacity_bottleneck
stages.action: Record nameplate, qualified, contracted, commissioned and utilized quantities with units/geography/period and operational constraint
stages.owner: B19 source research; B05 verified edges

stages.name: qc
stages.action: Validate as-of chronology, evidence references, duplicates, alternatives, cross-pool overlaps and denominator validity

priority_order: Classify unassigned operating issuers by issuer primary sources
Within each pool identify top actual final buyer budgets by disclosed USD spend
Map payer->tier1 supplier and competitors, then tier2+ supplier flows
Record contract financial states and capacity restrictions
Measure denominator-backed supplier shares; emit unknown for absent data
Evaluate bottleneck shifts and falsifying evidence
acceptance: Every tracked manifest entry appears once in low-resolution map
Zero inferred contracts treated as verified
One or more provisional pool roles where economically plausible; unknown otherwise
No issuer-dollar claims without source-supported period and financial classification
Pool dollar coverage is null until disjoint source-supported buyer denominators exist
Repeat analysis on pinned upstream manifest changes and report delta, not duplicate rows
